request.style: English, Gregorian chant, plainsong sung in unison by a schola of male monks, no instruments, free unmetered rhythm, Dorian mode, long stone abbey reverb, meditative and austere, 60 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Our Father in heaven
Hallowed be your name
Your kingdom come
Your will be done
On earth as it is in heaven

[Verse]
Give us today our daily bread
And forgive us our debts
As we also have forgiven our debtors

[Verse]
And lead us not into temptation
But deliver us from evil

[Outro]
Amen
